# Laxico Advertising

> Leading full-stack outdoor advertising (OOH/DOOH) media network in India. Managing 250+ prime billboards, highway unipoles, metro station dominations, airport arrival displays, bus shelter kiosks, digital LED screens, and creative media channels across 12 major Indian cities with verified footfall reporting and 48-hour campaign deployment.

## Core Media Services & Channels
- [All Media Services](https://lexicoadvertising.com/services): Complete directory of outdoor advertising channels, dimensions, verified footfall metrics, and live rates.
- [Highway Unipoles & City Hoardings](https://lexicoadvertising.com/category/Outdoor): Large-format frontlit unipoles and cantilever hoardings on NH-48 (Delhi-Gurugram), Western Express Highway (Mumbai), and Outer Ring Road (Bengaluru).
- [Metro Station Branding & Train Wraps](https://lexicoadvertising.com/category/Transit): Concourse lightboxes, platform screen doors (PSD), pillar wraps, and exterior train coach wrapping across DMRC, Namma Metro Bengaluru, and Mumbai Metro networks.
- [Airport Terminal Advertising](https://lexicoadvertising.com/category/Airport): Premium Indira Gandhi International (DEL T3), Kempegowda (BLR T1/T2), and Mumbai (BOM T2) arrival corridors, aerobridge wraps, and conveyor belt displays.
- [Digital DOOH LED Screens](https://lexicoadvertising.com/category/Digital): High-resolution 4K P2.5/P3 outdoor LED screens at DLF Cyber Hub, BKC, Whitefield, and premier tech corridors with dynamic day-parting.
- [Cinema Advertising](https://lexicoadvertising.com/category/Cinema): On-screen 2K/4K DCP slides and Dolby Atmos commercial video spots across PVR INOX and Cinepolis multiplexes.
- [Retail & Mall Atrium Displays](https://lexicoadvertising.com/category/Retail): Atrium drop banners, facade glow signs, and elevator totems across Grade-A shopping malls.
- [Street Furniture & Pole Kiosks](https://lexicoadvertising.com/category/Street%20Furniture): Double-sided backlit arterial lamp post kiosks and bus queue shelters (BQS).
- [BTL & Corporate Activations](https://lexicoadvertising.com/category/BTL): Residential township canopies, tech park cafeteria sampling, and experiential lead capture.
- [Print Media Campaigns](https://lexicoadvertising.com/category/Print): Front page jackets, display ads, and custom inserts in leading national dailies.
- [Social Media Ad Campaigns](https://lexicoadvertising.com/category/Socialmedia): Hyper-local geo-targeted Meta (Instagram/Facebook), YouTube, and LinkedIn video campaigns synchronized with physical billboards.
- [Web & AdTech Development](https://lexicoadvertising.com/category/Development): Fast campaign landing pages, QR scan tracking, and lead CRM integrations.
- [Aerial Drone Light Shows](https://lexicoadvertising.com/category/Drone%20Marketing): Synchronized 100–500+ LED drone swarm shows painting 3D logos and scannable QR codes across night skies.

## Verified Campaign Proof & Case Studies
- [Campaign Portfolio](https://lexicoadvertising.com/portfolio): Live and completed campaigns for brands including Nike, Zomato, Samsung, HDFC Bank, Coca-Cola, Amazon, Tata, and Swiggy.

## Client Execution Workflow
1. Media Selection & Availability Check via instant platform search.
2. Location Lock & Rate Confirmation with transparent pricing and GST invoicing.
3. Artwork Pre-flight Check & In-House Plant Printing (720 DPI flex/vinyl) in Delhi.
4. Physical Mounting & Illumination within 48 hours (MCD / DMRC / AAI government permits).
5. Day and Night Geo-tagged Photo Proof of Display delivered weekly.
6. Campaign Completion Report with audited footfall and vehicular impression analytics.
